name: Node.js / TypeScript architecture controls
implemented_controls: Required domain/application roots and nonempty source scans
Configured lexical import/reexport boundaries, including type-only imports
Relative and explicitly configured alias path boundaries
Known literal loaders and rejection of unresolved known dynamic loaders

No database, auth, payment, tenancy, product coverage or deployed entry-point validation was performed.
